beats.title: Ankylosaurus family encounter and stealth ambush of Thrin
beats.summary: Caelynn and Bonogo approach a family of large dinosaur-like ankylosaurus creatures over 15 feet long; the creatures welcome Caelynn while Bonogo takes a broken plate-armor piece from a baby. The family returns to the trees. As darkness falls and bioluminescent patches light a path, Karsemine and Bonogo spot a stealthy figure climbing down a distant tree. Bonogo fires an arrow and the shape falls. The group finds a wounded woodland elf speaking in clicks, wearing a cloak of shimmering leaves and carrying a short bow and leaf-shaped short sword, who begs for peace in broken Common. Stafl casts Healing Word to close the wound, and through gestures learns the elf's name is Thrin, who lives in the trees, broke rules, and wants to leave the forest with the group. Thrin urges them to stop and camp, but the group must press on to save Mossford.

beats.title: Canopy ascent, humid forest, and drive to keep moving
beats.summary: Thrin shows the group handholds up into the canopy, where the atmosphere turns humid and dramatically colder, with much movement among the branches. They travel along natural bridges to a new forest section. Far below, spines of a large creature move through the bushes. Thrin fixes bridges as they continue to a completely silent area with a feeling of being watched. At a clearing, Thrin demands they camp, warning of giant flying bugs that attract bigger creatures when killed. Ephanna sends a magical owl to survey the forest and determines they are about halfway through; despite it feeling like 7pm, the owl sees dawn breaking. The group cannot delay any longer.

beats.title: Wyvern sneak-by and makeshift rope bridge at Broken Crossing
beats.summary: Karesmine asks Thrin why the forest is moving; Thrin explains the forest felt “gross” and needed to move after a “shiny rain” fell. Upon entering the next area Thrin becomes frightened and signals silence. Below, among deadfall branches and bodies, is a gargantuan wyvern, the largest creature any have seen. With help from Stafl and Caelynn, the group sneaks through in the branches above, including Baergrom with Thrin stuffing leaves in his armor. They reach the Broken Crossing, where Thrin stops them at a decaying broken bridge. The group plans a makeshift rope bridge: Ephanna teleports across and Baergrom tosses rope. After crossing, Thrin abruptly stops and signals quiet as Caelynn spots another creature like Thrin. Bonogo draws his sword, but Thrin motions for everyone to sneak by instead.

beats.title: Pool of water, giant buzzer, and The Fallen Spine crossing mishap
beats.summary: The group reaches another bridge end where there is no canopy above and a giant swirling pool of water below. As they debate paths, Thrin tells them to quietly climb down the trees while a giant creature buzzes overhead. Once the buzzing fades they take a side path around the pool and enter The Fallen Spine, a clearing dominated by a massive fallen tree whose roots were ripped out, its trunk forming a path over a low area. Thrin crosses first, his thumping footsteps betraying the hollow wood. Karsemine crosses deftly, then Baergrom tries quietly but takes a bad step and crashes through the trunk, grabbing the sides before falling completely inside. Karsemine notices sounds and Thrin starts to panic.

beats.title: Battle with the Mother of Broken Branches
beats.summary: Stafl rushes to pull Baergrom back onto the log, and Caelynn follows quietly but only makes it halfway before the group hears something massive moving in the mist along the treeline. The wyvern tracking them emerges from the mist as a gigantic head, long neck, and massive claws; called the Apex of the Canopy or Mother of Broken Branches, she launches at Caelynn, trying to grab and fly off with her, but misjudges and misses, taking a crackling Lightning Bolt in retaliation. Stealth forgotten, Bonogo leaps in and attacks twice with impressive damage. Karesmine casts Hunter’s Mark, discovers resistances and abilities tied to the creature being near her nest, then fires two longbow shots. Stafl casts Hideous Laughter, causing the Mother to go prone, half on the log and half on the ground. Caelynn launches another Lightning Bolt. Ephanna casts Hunger of Hadar, a terrible sphere of darkness dealing cold then acid damage. Thrin fires two longbow arrows. Baergrom attacks with three mighty axe swings, severing the tail as the beast slides off the log to the ground.
